settings.help: Stricter mode: when the UI locks, keys are wiped and the password is required.

settings.label: Ask before the web is used in a chat
settings.help: The first time the assistant wants to search or open a website in a chat, you are asked once; the answer covers that chat until you sign out or restart.
settings.risk: The assistant may use web search in any chat without asking you first.

settings.label: Fetch any site
settings.risk: The agent may fetch any public website (still subject to SSRF rules, DLP and sensitivity rules).

settings.label: Allow plain HTTP
settings.risk: Pages may be fetched without encryption.

settings.label: Accept files that no antivirus could scan
settings.help: Normally a file that cannot be scanned (Microsoft Defender is off because another antivirus is active) stays in quarantine. Switching this on lets such files in after all the built-in checks (type, structure, active content, isolated parsing); they are marked 'not antivirus-scanned'. You can also release single files from the Quarantine list.
settings.risk: Malware that your other antivirus would have caught is not caught by this app. Keep your antivirus's real-time protection on.

settings.label: Summarise new files automatically
settings.help: After a file is ready, a local model writes a short summary, type and keywords (editable in the file's details) and adds a memory about where the file is and what it is. Secret values such as a PAN or card number are never copied into the summary or the memory.

settings.label: Runs shown in the step timeline (older are archived)
Learn about me automatically
settings.help: The assistant notes lasting facts and preferences from what you type in chats, from routines you switch on and from files you add to My Files. Nothing secret or ID-like is ever stored. Everything appears in Memory where you can edit or forget it; forgotten items are never learned again.

settings.label: Auto-confirm low-importance preferences
settings.risk: The agent may store small preferences without asking.

settings.label: Show names in Windows notifications
settings.help: The notification title is the name of the reminder, routine or chat it is about (like Claude's own notifications). Only names you or the assistant gave - never the content of mail or documents.
settings.risk: Names of your reminders, routines and chats can be read on screen (and on the lock screen if Windows allows it).

settings.label: Notification content
settings.help: 'summary' never includes CONFIDENTIAL content.

settings.label: Email-to-self summary via Microsoft 365
settings.risk: A summary email is sent through Microsoft 365.

settings.label: Keep rotated logs (days)
settings.risk: Security logs are deleted sooner.

settings.label: Forward to SIEM
settings.risk: Log metadata is sent to your SIEM.

settings.label: Check for updates automatically
settings.help: Updates are never installed silently.

settings.label: Read images and scanned pages with the vision model
settings.help: When you upload or attach a picture, a photo of a document or a scanned PDF, the vision model transcribes it into text automatically. Needs a vision model under Vision models above.

settings.label: Pages read per scanned PDF
settings.help: Scans are read page by page; each page takes a few seconds to a minute on the local model.

settings.label: Default context length (tokens)
settings.help: Used by every model that has no value of its own (a model's 'Adjust' overrides it). Ollama and the built-in runtime apply it.

settings.label: Default temperature
settings.help: Used by every model that has no value of its own. Lower = steadier and more factual.
